system_description.narrative_title: France's unrest sparks sovereign bond stress and global safe‑haven flows
system_description.narrative_summary: Mass protests, violent unrest and political uncertainty in France have materially raised sovereign risk perceptions, pushing French borrowing costs and risk premia toward euro‑crisis levels while prompting ratings scrutiny. That rise in perceived euro‑area sovereign risk has driven cross‑border capital flows into safe‑haven assets (notably US Treasuries), producing volatility and repricing across global bond markets. As an open system this involves feedbacks among protest intensity, government fiscal needs, investor sentiment, ratings actions, and central‑bank/market responses that transmit shocks across borders.
system_description.scope: French sovereign finances and bond markets, domestic political stability and protest dynamics, investor flows between eurozone assets and global safe havens (e.g., US Treasuries), credit‑rating scrutiny, and immediate central‑bank/market reactions.
system_description.super_system: Global financial system and macroeconomic stability (international capital markets, cross‑border risk transmission).
adjacent_subsystems: Eurozone fiscal architecture and the European Central Bank
Global fixed‑income and safe‑haven asset markets (US Treasuries, German Bunds)
French domestic politics, public security and social stability
Credit rating agencies and institutional investors

variables.name: Protest intensity
variables.description: The aggregate level and frequency of public demonstrations, riots and related street unrest within the polity.

variables.name: Political uncertainty level
variables.description: The perceived unpredictability of policy choices, government stability and policymaking outcomes.

variables.name: Sovereign borrowing cost
variables.description: The prevailing market interest rate required to borrow on the sovereign debt markets (representative yield level).

variables.name: Sovereign risk premium
variables.description: The spread that compensates investors for sovereign-specific credit, liquidity and event risks versus a baseline risk-free benchmark.

variables.name: Foreign investor share of sovereign debt
variables.description: The proportion of outstanding sovereign securities held by non‑resident investors.

variables.name: Capital flows to safe‑haven assets
variables.description: The net cross‑border volume of funds moving into assets considered safe havens over a given period.

variables.name: Bond market volatility
variables.description: The short‑to‑medium term variability in sovereign and major bond yields and prices.

variables.name: Government bond market liquidity
variables.description: The ease, depth and cost of transacting sovereign bonds as reflected in bid‑ask spreads and market depth.

variables.name: Perceived credit rating downgrade probability
variables.description: Market-implied or consensus estimate of the likelihood that a sovereign's credit rating will be lowered.

variables.name: Sovereign fiscal financing need
variables.description: The magnitude of gross financing (debt issuance and rollover) the sovereign must cover over a defined horizon.

variables.name: Policy rate expectations
variables.description: Market expectations about the future path and level of policy interest rates set by monetary authorities.

variables.name: Cross‑border risk transmission strength
variables.description: The degree to which shocks in one jurisdiction propagate to financial conditions and asset prices in other jurisdictions.

variables.name: Investor risk aversion
variables.description: The aggregate appetite for risk across market participants, affecting demand for risky versus safe assets.

variables.name: Bond market repricing rate
variables.description: The speed and magnitude at which bond yields and prices adjust in response to new information or shocks.

variables.name: Sovereign bond demand‑supply imbalance
variables.description: The gap between aggregate investor demand for sovereign bonds and the supply of those bonds available for purchase.

variables.name: Sovereign spread correlation
variables.description: The degree of co‑movement between sovereign credit spreads across different markets or jurisdictions.

catalysts.title: Continued weekend mass protests
catalysts.description: Ongoing large-scale demonstrations and repeat weekend mobilisations across France are likely to continue, sustaining political disruption and market attention.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Hundreds of Thousands Protest Across France', 'more weekend protests expected', 'France prepares for more protests with big police deployment'.

catalysts.title: Accelerated foreign selling of French sovereign debt
catalysts.description: Foreign investors increase offloading of French bonds, reducing non‑resident holdings and pressuring spreads and liquidity.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'France’s Debt Crisis Deepens as Foreign Investors Look for the Exit', 'France's borrowing costs hit 5%'.

catalysts.title: Ongoing safe‑haven flows into U.S. Treasuries and other havens
catalysts.description: Investors continue shifting capital into perceived safe assets, driving down US yields and drawing liquidity away from stressed sovereigns.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'U.S. 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls Under 5% as French Turmoil Fuels Flight for Safety', 'Treasury Yields Fall as Investors Seek Safe Haven'.

catalysts.title: Credit rating reviews or agency actions
catalysts.description: Ongoing scrutiny by rating agencies and potential follow‑up reviews could alter perceived sovereign credit risk and market pricing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'France is getting its credit rating reviewed', 'Unrest-hit France poised for Moody's ratings verdict', 'Moody's keeps France's credit rating unchanged'.

catalysts.title: Near‑term central bank policy decisions
catalysts.description: Upcoming policy meetings and rate moves by major central banks will reshape global yield curves and reallocate capital flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Week Ahead for FX, Bonds: Decisions From Fed, Other Central Banks in Focus', 'Bank of Canada to raise rates Oct 28 (Reuters poll)'.

catalysts.title: Government tightening of protest rules and bans
catalysts.description: New bans and tougher policing measures by the government may change protest dynamics and investor perceptions, with ambiguous effects.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Macron tightens curbs on protests', 'Macron warns some protests will be banned', 'France boosts police presence'.
